description: Figure 2, captioned “Ever-scalingness,” is a circular diagram divided into four colored segments arranged around a central point, each labeled with a distinct property and accompanied by an icon. The top-left segment is yellow and labeled “Uncrushable” with a ladder icon; the top-right segment is light blue and labeled “Unhackable” with a shield icon; the bottom-left segment is red and labeled “Auto-verifiable” with a clipboard and checkmark icon; and the bottom-right segment is green and labeled “General” with a globe icon. The central area of the circle contains the text “Complexity” next to the yellow segment, “Instance” next to the blue segment, “Coverage” next to the green segment, and “Oversight” next to the red segment. The figure includes a legend with four rectangular boxes corresponding to each segment’s color and label: “Uncrushable” (yellow), “Unhackable” (blue), “Auto-verifiable” (red), and “General” (green). There are no percentage labels inside the slices, and no slices are visually emphasized or exploded. The segments appear to be arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top-left.
